name: Summer Youth Sailing Program
description_short: Weekday sailing and windsurfing classes for ages 5-17 at Community Boating Center. Programs include Summer Youth Sailing (ages 7-17), Sea Squirts (ages 5-6) and Windsurfing (ages 9-17), with free breakfast and lunch and financial aid available.
swim_waterfront_notes: On-the-water program held rain or shine; students should come prepared to get wet. Closed-toe shoes (water shoes or old sneakers) are mandatory; bring a bathing suit, towel and change of clothes. Sea Squirts (ages 5-6) mixes sailing, games and swimming, with a focus on water safety. Staff limit on-the-water activity when they judge conditions unsafe.
